execution.result_contract: Source validation emits compact mode results; installation emits OK on payload-free success or one structured phase, skill, rollback, and reason blocker; inventory writes valid routing entries and malformed direct-manifest blockers to the caller-selected file and emits OK.

checks.pass_condition: The source manifest declares a nonempty stable runtime_source_id and either the ceratops or ceratops-compatible validation profile; full validation always applies common checks and only the ceratops profile adds Ceratops-specific icon, contract, retired-artifact, and repository-governance checks.

The live deployment file validates as version 1 structured operations with argv-array steps and repository-relative working directories; the reusable template remains an empty version 1 skeleton. The ceratops profile declares after_promote with one base_revision parameter and one affected-set installer invocation, declares after_ship with one all-managed installer invocation, and includes both reusable templates in the installed repository-lifecycle payload.

The external installer template and AI-Agent-Skills bootstrap declare the same explicit positive integer INSTALLER_VERSION but implement separate tiers. Behavior tests prove the bootstrap uses only its checkout lifecycle bundle and the standard-library external installer succeeds independently, ignores installed Ceratops bundles, and fails unresolved input without fallback. Compatible repositories retain same- or higher-version installers and synchronize only missing or lower versions through task worktrees.

deterministic_evidence: source SKILL.md section and subsection structure
checks.pass_condition: Source skill frontmatter contains only name and description; name matches the directory, contains 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens, does not start or end with a hyphen, and contains no consecutive hyphens; description contains 40 to 1024 characters; the body contains a Markdown H2 section structure; the ceratops profile additionally requires Boundaries and Output Contract subsections.

OpenAI interface metadata exists, default_prompt names the skill, display name resembles the skill identity, and short description overlaps the trigger description; the ceratops profile additionally requires icon fields, shared Ceratops icon paths, and matching bytes.

Every source skill has a manifest assignment including core, source SKILL.md files remain delta-only, assigned shared sections render, and source files do not contain generated runtime shared-section blocks.

Every skill assigned the multi-action-skill section has one complete Action References index with at least two unique direct references/*.md paths; every mapped file exists and uses an Action title, and every top-level reference with an Action title is indexed.

Each skill folder contains `SKILL.md` as the only top-level file and uses only profile-supported resource directories; the compatible profile may include `tests/`, while the ceratops profile allows `agents/`, `assets/`, `scripts/`, and `references/`. Reference files remain within supported nesting.
Runtime payload declarations point only to existing repo-relative paths or matching globs and do not use absolute paths or parent-directory traversal.

The installer resolves an explicit, base-revision, or all-managed affected set before mutation and invokes one locked batch transaction. Every selected present skill stages and validates before canonical mutation; existing targets retire, the complete staged batch activates, and pre-commit failures restore the prior batch. Targeted installs remove only declared absent skills; all-managed installs include same-source stale skills. Inventory reads direct manifests only and does not claim runtime validation.
Every source skill has a row in the README Skills table and every row in that table points to an existing source skill directory, without requiring a name prefix.
Files copied into or rendered into managed runtime skills do not contain high-confidence secret patterns or user-local absolute filesystem paths.

The source-doc registry and contract-review action own skill-design standards refresh, the validator owns deterministic compliance, and the repository consistency action owns manual non-deterministic compliance without silently changing the contracts.

deterministic_evidence: structured runtime manifests and section assignments
skill deterministic and nondeterministic contract mappings
checks.pass_condition: Full source validation checks structured repository data, portable runtime inputs, current skill identities, README alignment, and profile-aware governance. Executable behavior is established through import, CLI, filesystem-state, and transaction tests rather than source markers, syntax-tree form, source hashes, or executable source-anchor metadata.
